title: Position-keyed deterministic and batch-invariant sampling
inspiration: DeepInfer batch-invariant inference; Qwen3.8 already uses Philox keyed by seed and token position.

delta.qwen38: Add a non-destructive strict-profile generator that freezes expert placement and a live endpoint assertion for serial/interleaving verification.
delta.qwen36: Replace mutable mt19937_64 host draws with the same position-keyed Philox contract.

evidence: qwen35_philox_test passes in the CUDA 13.1 120-real build. On RTX 5090, fixed expert placement passed 13/13 serial/interleaved sampled hashes; synchronous adaptive placement failed 1/5. Raw evidence is under reports/data/deterministic-sm120/.
acceptance: For each tested seed and sampling configuration, all serial target hashes and all target hashes produced beside unrelated concurrent requests are identical.
rollback: Keep the original performance profile and select it instead of the generated strict profile.
